<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>A sequence detector for detecting the specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Reset signal for initialization.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit input signal for the bitstream.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal indicating if the sequence is detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Initial state waiting for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State representing the first bit of the sequence being detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State representing the second bit of the sequence being detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State representing the third bit of the sequence being detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State representing the fourth bit of the sequence being detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="current_state" type="reg" width_description="[2:0]">Current state of the sequence detector.</signal>
        <signal id="next_state" type="wire" width_description="[2:0]">Next state of the sequence detector.</signal>
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n)>
            if (reset_n == 1'b1)
                current_state <= IDLE;
            else
                current_state <= next_state;
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        case(current_state)
            IDLE: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b1)
                    next_state = S1;
                else
                    next_state = IDLE;
            end
            
            S1: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b0)
                    next_state = S2;
                else
                    next_state = S1;
            end
            
            S2: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b0)
                    next_state = S3;
                else
                    next_state = S1;
            end
            
            S3: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b1)
                    next_state = S4;
                else
                    next_state = IDLE;
            end
            
            S4: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b1)
                    next_state = S1;
                else
                    next_state = IDLE;
            end
            
            default: next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
        
        // Output logic
        assign sequence_detected = (current_state == S4 && data_in == 1'b1);
        
    </implementation>
</module>
